messages:
Priya: quick ping — candidate (L4 SRE) interview tomorrow 10:30am PT / 18:30 UTC. Need coverage: infra, backend, systems. Also need a scribe + someone to run the takehome debrief. who can cover?
Elena: I can cover backend and do the scribe if nobody else volunteers. happy to take notes. :+1:
Samir: heads up i’m on a call until 11am PT, so can only join late. if infra is still open i can hop in at ~11:10 PT and take the tail end.
Priya: ok noted. can we confirm rubric weighting — quick Q for people-ops/product: is takehome 30% or 40%? also want to call out partial-credit rules for system design.
Marta: we standardized to 30% takehome / 50% live / 20% culture last quarter (see rubric doc). partial credit: give credit for safe tradeoffs and core signals, not perfect implementations. link: https://docs.redwood.ai/interviews/rubric (please DM if access issues)
Samir: thanks — that helps. quick follow: for live infra troubleshooting, do we still deduct for using internet lookup? I remember a note but can't find it.
Priya: policy is allowed to reference docs but not run code that changes infra. if they search for a command, ask them to explain reasoning. deduction only if they blindly paste without justification. keep it lightweight.
Aisha: candidate gave verbal recording consent in scheduling call but wants confirmation in writing. can someone send the consent prompt at the start?
Elena: i’ll do the consent prompt and confirm in the chat.
Marta: I’ll take infra panel. Samir — if you join late i’ll handoff whiteboard notes to you.
Samir: perfect, thanks Marta.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: panel checklist due 2 hours before interview. Please upload scorecard to /interview-scorecards and confirm scribe.
Priya: thanks everyone — quick checklist below (paste into calendar or thread):
```
10:10 PT — panel joins and quick sync (consent + role brief)
10:30 PT — candidate intro
11:10 PT — Samir joins (if needed) / handoff
12:00 PT — debrief + scorecards submitted
```
Elena: copied. i’ll post the scribe notes and link to recording after.
Aisha: will DM candidate the written consent and post confirmation here.
Priya: amazing — closing loop: panel = Marta (infra), Elena (backend + scribe), Samir (backup, joins late), Aisha (org/culture), Priya (takehome debrief). thanks everyone :raised_hands:
